name: muapi-fashion-try-on
tagline_zh: 上传人像和单品，秒换新装还能生成模特走秀视频。连衣褶光影都自然，像真在店里试穿。
tagline_en: Upload a photo and a garment, get a realistic try-on plus an optional model runway video. Seams, folds.
desc_en: Virtually try on different outfits by combining a person's photo and a clothing item, then optionally generate a professional fashion model video.
why_zh: 它把试穿和视频生成串成一条流水线，省去多工具切换，且衣物质感还原度比同类高。
why_en: It chains try-on and video into one pipeline, saving tool-switching, with fabric texture fidelity above typical alternatives.
